sections.title_en: Chapter: On wiping the head—how many times it is done
sections.title_ar: [باب في مسح الرأس كم مرة هو]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: [قال الإمام أبو بكر أحمد بن محمد بن هانىء الأثرم رحمه الله تعالى: حدثنا] أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ سِنَانٍ الْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ يجزىء مسحة للرأس.
entries.isnad_en: The Imam Abu Bakr Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Hani' al-Athram (may God the Exalted have mercy on him) said: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Sharik narrated to us, from Sinan al-Bajali, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: A single wipe of the head is sufficient.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر حدثنا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمن بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى فَدَعَا بِوَضوُءٍ وَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً وَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ ثَلاثًا وَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ عليا يتوضأ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr narrated to us. 'Abd al-Rahim b. Sulayman narrated to us, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, who said:
entries.matn_en: I went in to 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla; he called for water for ablution and wiped his head once and washed his feet three times, and said: “This is how I saw 'Ali perform ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يسأل عَنْ مَسْحِ مَرَّةٍ ⦗ص: 228⦘ وَاحِدَةٍ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: [He was asked] about a single wipe [of the head] [p. 228] and he said: Yes.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On wiping the head—how it is done

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بن بحر حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم حدثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ أَبِي الأَزْهَرِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَرَاهُمْ وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَسْحَ رَأْسِهِ وَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِهِمَا حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْقَفَا ثُمَّ رَدَّهُمَا حَتَّى بَلَغَ إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي مِنْهُ بَدَأَ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Ali b. Bahr narrated to us. al-Walid b. Muslim narrated to us. 'Abd Allah b. al-'Ala' narrated to us, from Abu al-Azhar, from Mu'awiya:
entries.matn_en: That he showed them the ablution of the Messenger of God ﷺ. When he reached the wiping of his head, he placed his palms on the front of his head, then passed them over it until he reached the nape, then brought them back until he reached the place from which he had begun.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حماد أخبرنا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ يَمْسَحُ رأسه ببلل يَدَيْهِ مِنْ مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ إِلَى الْقَفَا ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُمَا إِلَى مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. Hisham b. 'Urwa informed us:
entries.matn_en: That his father used to wipe his head with the moisture of his hands, from the front of his head to the nape, then return them to the front of his head.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حَمَّادٌ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ زَعَمَ حُمَيْدٌ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بِمِثْلِهِ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us, who said: Humayd claimed, from al-Hasan, the like of it.
entries.matn_en: The like of the preceding report (no. 5).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يسأل عَنْ مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ كَيْفَ هُوَ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا،
entries.matn_ar: وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ كِلْتَيْهِمَا عَلَى مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ ⦗ص: 229⦘ جَرَّهُمَا إِلَى مُؤَخَّرِ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ رَدَّهُمَا جَمِيعًا إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي مِنْهُ بَدَأَ وَذَلِكَ كُلُّهُ فِي مَرَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ لَمْ يَرْفَعْهُمَا عَنْ رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: عَلَى حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ. قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: وَحَدِيثُ عَلِيٍّ هَكَذَا، وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ جَرَّهُمَا إِلَى قَفَاهُ وَلَمْ يَرُدَّهُمَا.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about wiping the head, how it is done. He said: Like this—and he placed both his hands on the front of his head, then [p. 229] drew them to the back of his head, then returned them both to the place from which he began, all of that in one pass, without lifting them from his head. Then he said: According to the hadith of 'Abd Allah b. Zayd. Abu 'Abd Allah said: And the hadith of 'Ali is like this: he placed his hands on the front of his head, then drew them to his nape and did not return them.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On the two ears—are they part of the head?
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ فِي الأُذُنَيْنِ أَمِنَ الرَّأْسِ هُمَا

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عفان حدثنا حماد بن زيد حدثنا سِنَانٌ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ وَصَفَ وُضُوءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ثَلاثًا ثَلاثًا وَلا أَدْرِي كَيْفَ ذَكَرَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقَ وَقَالَ الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرأس.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Hammad b. Zayd narrated to us. Sinan narrated to us, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from Abu Umama:
entries.matn_en: That he described the ablution of the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned three times each—“and I do not know how he mentioned rinsing the mouth and sniffing water”—and he said: “The two ears are part of the head.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ ⦗ص: 230⦘ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَالْحَسَنِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالا الأذنان من الرأس.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. 'Abd al-Rahim b. Sulayman narrated to us, [p. 230] from Sa'id, from Qatada, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab and al-Hasan, who both said:
entries.matn_en: The two ears are part of the head.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر حدثنا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرأس.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr narrated to us. 'Abd al-Rahim b. Sulayman narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, from Abu Musa, who said:
entries.matn_en: The two ears are part of the head.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَأْخُذ [المَاءَ بأصبعيه] لأذنيه.
entries.isnad_en: al-Qa'nabi narrated to us, from Malik, from Nafi':
entries.matn_en: That 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar used to take water with his two fingers for his ears.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يُسأل الأُذُنَانِ مِنَ الرَّأْسِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: whether the two ears are part of the head. He said: Yes.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On wiping over the turban

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جعفر النفيلي حدثنا زهير حدثنا ⦗ص: 231⦘ حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ جَالِسًا بِدِمَشْقَ فِي يَوْمٍ بَارِدٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْلَعَ خُفَّيْهِ لِلْوُضُوءِ فَمَرَّ بِهِ بِلالٌ مُؤَذِّنُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا بِلالُ كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ قَالَ كَانَ يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ وَالْخِمَارِ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَتَرَكَ خُفَّيْهِ فَلَمْ يَخْلَعْهُمَا.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Ja'far al-Nufayli narrated to us. Zuhayr narrated to us. [p. 231] Humayd al-Tawil narrated to us, from Abu Raja', from Abu Idris:
entries.matn_en: That he was sitting in Damascus on a cold day and performed ablution, and wanted to take off his leather socks (khuffs) for the ablution. Bilal, the mu'adhdhin of the Messenger of God ﷺ, passed by him, and he said: O Bilal, how did the Messenger of God ﷺ perform ablution? He said: He used to wipe over the two khuffs and the head-cover (khimar). He said: Praise be to God—and he left his khuffs on and did not take them off.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا داود بن أبي الفرات حدثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ مَوْلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ سَلْمَانَ فَرَأَى رَجُلا قَدْ أَحْدَثَ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْزِعَ خُفَّيْهِ لِلْوُضُوءِ فَأَمَرَهُ سَلْمَانُ أَنْ يَمْسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ وَعِمَامَتِهِ [وَيَمْسَحَ بناصيته قال سَلْمَانُ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ وَعِمَامَتِهِ] .
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Dawud b. Abi al-Furat narrated to us. Muhammad b. Zayd narrated to us, from Abu Shurayh, from Abu Muslim, the freedman of Zayd b. Suhan, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was with Salman, and he saw a man who had broken ablution and wished to take off his khuffs for the ablution. Salman ordered him to wipe over his khuffs and his turban, and to wipe his forelock; Salman said: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ wipe over his khuffs and his turban.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ حدثنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ ثَوْرٍ عَنْ رَاشِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً فَأَصَابَهُمُ الْبَرْدُ فَلَمَّا قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَكَوْا إِلَيْهِ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ فَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَمْسَحُوا عَلَى الْعَصَائِبِ وَالتَّسَاخِينِ يَعْنِي الخفاف.
entries.isnad_en: Abu 'Abd Allah Ahmad b. Hanbal narrated to us. Yahya b. Sa'id narrated to us, from Thawr, from Rashid b. Sa'd, from Thawban, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent out a raiding party and they were struck by cold. When they came to the Messenger of God ﷺ they complained to him of what had befallen them, so he ordered them to wipe over the turbans ('asa'ib) and the tasakhin—meaning the khuffs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الحكم بن موسى حدثنا هِقْلٌ عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ وَالْخُفَّيْنِ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Hakam b. Musa narrated to us. Hiql narrated to us, from al-Awza'i. Yahya narrated to me, from Ja'far b. 'Amr, from 'Amr b. Umayya:
entries.matn_en: That he saw the Messenger of God ﷺ wipe over the turban and the two khuffs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثني أبو جعفر النفيلي حدثنا عفير بن معدان أبو خالد الحمصي حدثنا سُلَيْمَُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ البَاهِلِيّ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ وَالْعِمَامَةِ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Ja'far al-Nufayli narrated to me. 'Ufayr b. Ma'dan Abu Khalid al-Himsi narrated to us. Sulaym b. 'Amir narrated to us, from Abu Umama al-Bahili:
entries.matn_en: That the Messenger of God ﷺ wiped over the two khuffs and the turban during the expedition of Tabuk.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا أبو عَوَانة حدثنا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفْلَةَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَرْسَلْنَا نُبَاتَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُعْفِيَّ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَكَانَ أَجْرَأَنَا عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا سَلْهُ عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ وَالْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَأَخْبَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِلْمُقِيمِ فِي أهله إذا لبس خفيه غدوة طاهرا ما لم ينزعهما من شيء مسح عليهما [يوما إلى الليل] وللمسافر ثلاث [ولياليهن] وإن شاء مسح عَنْ رَأْسِهِ وَإِنْ شَاءَ مَسَحَ يَدَهُ عَلَى قلنسيته وعمامته.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Abu 'Awana narrated to us. 'Imran b. Muslim narrated to us, from Suwayd b. Ghafala, who said:
entries.matn_en: We sent Nubata b. 'Abd Allah al-Ju'fi to 'Umar b. al-Khattab—he was the boldest of us toward him—and we said: Ask him about ablution and wiping over the khuffs on a journey. He reported that 'Umar said: For the resident among his family, when he has put on his khuffs in the morning in a state of purity, so long as he has not taken them off, he may wipe over them [a day up to the night]; and for the traveller three [days and nights]. And if he wishes he may wipe over his head, and if he wishes he may wipe his hand over his skullcap and his turban.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا ثابت بن زيد حدثنا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَمَّنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ وَرَاحِلَتُهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَبَالَ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى عِمَامَتِهِ وَخُفَّيْهِ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Thabit b. Yazid narrated to us. 'Asim al-Ahwal narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: Anas b. Malik led us in prayer with his mount between him and the qibla; he urinated, then performed ablution and wiped over his turban and his two khuffs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يسأل عَنِ الْمَسْحِ عَلَى ⦗ص: 234⦘ الْعِمَامَةِ أَتَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ نعم.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about wiping over the turban—do you hold to it? He said: Yes. [p. 234]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الأَثْرَمُ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا مَسَحَ عَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ ثُمَّ خَلَعَهَا أَعَادَ وُضُوءَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَأَيُّ شَيْءٍ! .
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: If he wipes over the turban and then takes it off, does he repeat his ablution? He said: Yes—what else!

sections.title_en: Chapter: On one who forgets rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose in his ablution
sections.title_ar: بَابُ فِيمَنْ نَسِيَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقَ فِي وُضُوئِهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دكين حدثنا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ لَقِيطِ بْنِ صَبْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ وَخَلِّلِ الأَصَابِعَ، وَإِذَا اسْتَنْشَقْتَ فَبَالِغْ إِلا أَنْ تَكُونَ صَائِمًا.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Hashim, from 'Asim b. Laqit b. Sabira, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: “Perfect the ablution and run water between the fingers, and when you sniff water into your nose, be thorough—unless you are fasting.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مُعَاوِيةُ بن عمرو حدثنا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُور عَنْ هِلالٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَانْثُرْ [وَإِذَا] استجمرت فأوتر.
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiya b. 'Amr narrated to us. Za'ida narrated to us, from Mansur, from Hilal, from Salama b. Qays, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “When you perform ablution, blow your nose out; and when you use stones for istijmar, do so in an odd number.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا حماد بن سلمة أخبرنا علي بن زيد عن سلمة بن مُحَمَّد بْن عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ عَنْ عَمَّار بْنِ يَاسِر
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ أَوِ الْفِطْرَةُ المضمضة والاستنشاق.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Hammad b. Salama narrated to us. 'Ali b. Zayd informed us, from Salama b. Muhammad b. 'Ammar b. Yasir, from 'Ammar b. Yasir, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Part of the fitra”—or “the fitra is”—“rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الْمَضْمَضَةُ والاستنشاق نصف الوضوء.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose are half of ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حدثنا موسى حدثنا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ عَطَاء بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاح قَالَ مَنْ نَسِيَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقَ قَالَ يُعِيدُ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us, from Qays b. Sa'd, from 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah, who said, regarding one who forgot rinsing the mouth and sniffing water:
entries.matn_en: He said: He repeats.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا عباد بن العوام عن عمرو بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يُعِيدُ الرَّجُلُ الْوُضُوءَ مِنْ نِسْيَانِ الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقِ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. 'Abbad b. al-'Awwam narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Amir, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man repeats the ablution because of forgetting to rinse the mouth and sniff water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا جرير عن مغيرة، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقَ أحب أن يقطع الصلاة ويعيد] .
entries.isnad_en: 'Uthman b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from Mughira:
entries.matn_en: That he said, regarding a man who forgot to rinse his mouth and sniff water: I prefer that he break off the prayer and repeat.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى حدثنا أَبَانٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى كَانَ يَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالاسْتِنْشَاقِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَدْخُلُ مَدْخَلَ الدم.
entries.isnad_en: Musa narrated to us. Aban narrated to us, from Qatada:
entries.matn_en: That Abu Musa used to say: “Hold fast to sniffing water, for Satan enters by the path of the blood.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا غندر عن شعبة عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ الْعَنْبَرِيَّ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَبْصَرَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ تَوَضَّأَ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى الْغُلامُ بِالْكُوزِ قَالَ نَسِيتُ أَمْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَاسْتَنْشَقَ مَرَّتَيْنِ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Ghundar narrated to us, from Shu'ba, from Abu Bishr, who said: I heard 'Umar al-'Anbari:
entries.matn_en: That he watched 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba perform ablution; when the servant-boy went off with the jug, he said: I forgot the command of the Messenger of God ﷺ—so he called for water and sniffed water into his nose twice.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا المنجاب بن الحارث أخبرنا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّةَ الْوَادِعِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَأَعْرِكْ أَنْفَكَ ثُمَّ انْثُرْ فَأَذْهِبْ مَا كَانَ فِي الْمَنْخِرَيْنِ مِنْ خَبَثٍ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Minjab b. al-Harith narrated to us. Ibn Abi Za'ida informed us, from his father, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Hayya al-Wadi'i, from 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: When you perform ablution, rub your nose, then blow it out, and so remove whatever filth is in the two nostrils.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يسأل عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقَ فِي وُضُوئِهِ قال يعيد الصلاة.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about a man who forgot rinsing the mouth and sniffing water in his ablution; he said: He repeats the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وكذلك سمعت أَبَا عُبَيْدٍ يَقُولُ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said:
entries.matn_en: And likewise I heard Abu 'Ubayd say.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُعِيدُهُمَا أَمْ يُعِيدُ الْوُضُوءَ كُلَّهُ قَالَ لا بَلْ يُعِيدُهُمَا وَلا يُعِيدُ الْوُضُوءَ لأَنَّهُمَا لَيْسَا مِمَّا سُمِّيَ فِي القرآن.
entries.isnad_en: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: Does he repeat the two [rinsing and sniffing] or repeat the whole ablution? He said: No, he repeats the two and does not repeat the ablution, because they are not among what is named in the Qur'an.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَنَسِيَ الْمَضْمَضَةَ وَحَدَّهَا؟ فَقَالَ الاسْتِنْشَاقُ عِنْدِي أَوْكَدُ.
entries.isnad_en: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: And if he forgot rinsing the mouth alone? He said: Sniffing water is, in my view, the more emphatic.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On rinsing the mouth and sniffing water with a single scoop
sections.title_ar: باب في المضمضة والاستنشاق بغرفة واحدة

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مُعَاوِيةُ بن عمرو حدثنا زائدة حدثنا خالد بن علقمة الهمداني حدثنا عَبْدُ خَيْرٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ الرَّحْبَةَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: لِغُلامٍ لَهُ ائْتِنِي بِطَهُورٍ ⦗ص: 238⦘ فَأَتَاهُ الْغُلامُ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ وَطَسْتٍ، قَالَ عَبْدُ خَيْرٍ: وَنَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ نَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى فِي الإِنَاءِ فَمَلأَ فَمَهُ فَمَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَنَثَرَ بِيَدِهِ الْيُسْرَى فَفَعَلَ هَكَذَا، ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: هَكَذَا طُهُورُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ ينظر إلى طُهُورُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فهذا طهوره.
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiya b. 'Amr narrated to us. Za'ida narrated to us. Khalid b. 'Alqama al-Hamdani narrated to us. 'Abd Khayr narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali entered the open court (al-Rahba), then said to a boy of his: Bring me water for purification. [p. 238] The boy brought him a vessel with water in it and a basin. 'Abd Khayr said: We were sitting watching him. He reported that he put his right hand into the vessel, filled his mouth and rinsed, and sniffed water and blew it out with his left hand; he did this three times. Then he said: “Such was the purification of the Prophet of God ﷺ; whoever would like to see the purification of the Prophet of God ﷺ, this is his purification.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حدثنا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ خَيْرٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ كَفٍّ واحد.
entries.isnad_en: Ahmad b. 'Abd Allah b. Yunus narrated to us. Sharik narrated to us, from Khalid b. 'Alqama, from 'Abd Khayr:
entries.matn_en: That 'Ali rinsed his mouth and sniffed water from a single handful.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَأَيْتُ الْحَسَنَ وَابْنَ سِيرِينَ يَأْخُذَانِ غَرْفَةً فَيَسْتَنْشِقَانِ وَيَتَمَضْمَضَانِ مِنْهَا.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Mahdi b. Maymun narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin each take one scoop, and sniff water and rinse the mouth from it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: قال رأيت ابن عمر يتمضمض وَيَسْتَنْشِقُ مِنْ كَفٍّ وَاحِدٍ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. 'Abbad b. al-'Awwam narrated to us, from Jamil b. Zayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw Ibn 'Umar rinse his mouth and sniff water from a single handful.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: قلت لأبي عبد الله يتمضمض الرَّجُلُ وَيَسْتَنْشِقُ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَعَاوَدْتُهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ لِحَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم..، وَذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ مِنْ حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ الْوَاسِطِيِّ. قُلْتُ: وفِي حَدِيثِ عَلِيٍّ شَرِيكٌ يَقُولُهُ قَالَ: زَائِدَةُ جَوَّدَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: May a man rinse his mouth and sniff water from one scoop? He said: Yes. I asked him again and he said: Yes, on account of the hadith of the Prophet ﷺ—and he mentioned the hadith of 'Abd Allah b. Zayd through Khalid al-Wasiti. I said: And in the hadith of 'Ali, Sharik says it; he said: Za'ida transmitted it well.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ
entries.matn_ar: أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى يُسْأَلُ أَيُّمَا أَعْجَبُ إِلَيْكَ الْمَضْمَضَةُ وَالاسْتِنْشَاقُ بِغَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ أَمْ كُلٌّ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَةٍ فَقَالَ بغرفة واحدة.
entries.isnad_en: He said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah another time being asked:
entries.matn_en: Which do you prefer—rinsing and sniffing from a single scoop, or each separately? He said: From a single scoop.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On moving the ring in ablution

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ حدثنا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَزَالَ خَاتَمَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar b. Muhammad b. Aban narrated to us. Talha b. Sinan narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar:
entries.matn_en: That when he performed ablution he would remove his ring.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو زكريا السيلحيني حدثنا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ هُبَيْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيِّ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَبْد اللهِ بن عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ نَزَعَ حَلْقَةً كَانَتْ فِي يَدِهِ، فَإِذَا فَرَغَ لَبِسَهَا. ⦗ص: 240⦘ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هُبَيْرَةَ أَنَا وأبو تميم نفعل ذلك.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Zakariyya al-Silahini narrated to us. Ibn Lahi'a narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Hubayra, from Abu Tamim al-Jayshani, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr b. al-'As, when he performed ablution, take off a ring he had on his hand, and when he finished he put it back on. [p. 240] 'Abd Allah b. Hubayra said: Abu Tamim and I do that.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل حدثنا مِسْعَرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَمَّادًا
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ أَزِلِ الْخَاتَمَ. قَالَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ: يَعْنِي، إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl narrated to us. Mis'ar narrated to us, who said: I heard Hammad say:
entries.matn_en: “Remove the ring.” Abu Nu'aym said: He means, when he performs ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الطَّبَّاعِ حَدَّثَنِي رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ إِيَاسِ بْنِ نَذِيرٍ عَنْ عِمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ حَرَّكَ خَاتَمَهُ حَتَّى يُصِيبَهُ الْمَاءُ.
entries.isnad_en: Ibn al-Tabba' narrated to me. Rifa'a b. Iyas b. Nadhir narrated to me, from 'Umara b. al-Qa'qa' b. Shubruma, who said:
entries.matn_en: When Ibrahim performed ablution he would move his ring until the water reached it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: سمعت أبا عبد الله يسأل
entries.matn_ar: عَنْ تَحْرِيكِ الْخَاتَمِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ فَقَالَ إِذَا كَانَ وَاسِعًا يَدْخُلُهُ الْمَاءُ أَجْزَأَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ ضيقا لا يدخله الماء حركه.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about moving the ring in ablution. He said: If it is loose and water gets under it, that suffices; and if it is tight and water does not get under it, he moves it.

sections.title_en: Chapter: [On the man who performs ablution and sloshes his feet in the water]
sections.title_ar: باب [في الرجل يتوضأ فيخضخض رجليه في الماء]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ أَبِي حَرَّةَ ⦗ص: 241⦘ عَنِ الحَسَنِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ إِذَا خَضْخَضَ رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الماءِ فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَهُ في الوضوء.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Hushaym narrated to us, from Abu Harra, [p. 241] from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: If he sloshes his feet in the water, that suffices him in ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الأَثْرَمُ: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ خَلَّلَ أَصَابِعَ رِجْلَيْهِ حِينَ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى سَائِرِ قَدَمَيْهِ قَالَ أَمَّا الحَدِيثُ فَإِنَّمَا جَاءَ "غَسْلُ رِجْلَيْهِ" مَعَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ قَدْ أَجَازَ أَنْ يُخَضْخِضَ قدميه] .
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about a man who ran water between the toes of his feet when he performed ablution, then poured water over the rest of his feet. He said: As for the hadith, what came was “the washing of his feet”; though more than one [authority] has permitted sloshing the feet.

sections.title_en: Chapters on Waters. Chapter: What renders water impure and what does not

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: بَابُ مَا يُنَجِّسُ الْمَاءَ وَمَا لا ينجسه . [حدثنا يوسف بن كامل حدثنا عبد العزيز بن مسلم حدثنا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي نوف عن سليط عن عبد الرحمن بن أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ مِنْ بِئْرِ بِضَاعَةَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ الله هذه تلقى فيها النتن فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم المَاءُ لا يَنْجَسُ.
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf b. Kamil narrated to us. 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Muslim narrated to us. Mutarrif b. Tarif narrated to us, from Khalid b. Abi Nawf, from Sulayt, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Sa'id, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ perform ablution from the well of Buda'a. I said: O Messenger of God, foul things are thrown into this. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Water is not made impure.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ المِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زريع عن مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسأل عَنِ الْمَاءِ يَكُونُ بِالْفَلاةِ تَنُوبُهُ الدَّوَابُّ وَالسِّبَاعُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ قَدْرَ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يَحْمِلِ الْخَبَثَ.
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. al-Minhal narrated to us. Yazid b. Zuray' narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Muhammad b. Ja'far b. al-Zubayr, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, from his father:
entries.matn_en: That he heard the Prophet ﷺ being asked about water in open desert that is visited by beasts and predators. The Prophet ﷺ said: “If the water reaches the measure of two qullas, it does not carry impurity (khabath).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَلُ
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ الْبِئْرِ تقع فيها السِّنَّوْرُ ⦗ص: 243⦘ وَمَا أَشْبَهُهُ فَقَالَ إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ كَثِيرًا وَلَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ فَلا يَنْجُسُ قِيلَ لَهُ وَلا يُنْزَحُ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ قَالَ لا فَذُكِرَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دَاوُدَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَوْ أَنَّ إِنْسَانًا أَصَابَ سِنَّوْرًا قَدْ تَفَسَّخَ فِي بِئْرٍ وَقَدْ كَانَ توضأ مِنْهَا لَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَعِدْ صَلاةَ ثَلاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَضَحِكَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَالْمُتَعَجِّبِ وَقَالَ مِنْ أين قال ثلاثة أيام قيل له تقول إن السنور لا تتفسخ فِي أَقَلِّ مِنْ ثَلاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ قَالَ فَلَعَلَّهَا تَفَسَّخَتْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّمَا يَكُونُ القياس على أصل يشبه وعليه هَذَا مِنْ أَيْنَ جَاءَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ أَيْضًا يَقُولُ لَوْ أخرجها من ساعتها ينجس الْمَاءُ كَالْمُنْكِرِ لِذَلِكَ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about a well into which a cat [p. 243] or the like falls. He said: If the water is plentiful and has not changed, it is not made impure. He was asked: And nothing is drawn out of it? He said: No. Then it was mentioned to Abu 'Abd Allah [the view] of 'Abd Allah b. Dawud, that he said: If a person found a cat that had decomposed in a well from which he had performed ablution, I would tell him to repeat the prayers of three days. Abu 'Abd Allah laughed as one astonished and said: From where did he get ‘three days’? It was said to him: He means that a cat does not decompose in less than three days. He said: Perhaps it decomposed before that. Then he said: Analogy (qiyas) is only on a similar basis, and on that—from where did he come with this? Then Abu 'Abd Allah said: He also says that if he took it out at once, the water would be impure—[saying this] as one rejecting it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ إِذَا [كان] الْمَاءُ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يُنَجِّسْهُ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّرَ طَعْمًا أَوْ رِيحًا إِلا مِنَ الْبَوْلِ وَالْغَائِطِ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: He said: And I heard Abu 'Abd Allah say: When the water is two qullas, nothing makes it impure until it changes in taste or smell—except for urine and feces.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَلُ كَمِ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ فقال قالوا قربتين.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked: How much are the two qullas? He said: They said: two water-skins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل عَنْ تَفْسِيرِ الْقُلَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ الْقُلَّةُ قِرْبَتَانِ هَكَذَا فَسَّرَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ فِي كَلامِهِ] .
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked about the explanation of the two qullas. He said: The qulla is two water-skins; thus Ibn Jurayj explained it in his discourse.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ بَحْرٍ المعنى واحد قالا حدثنا حاتم بن إسماعيل حدثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي يَحْيَى عَنْ أُمِّهِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ فِي نِسْوَةٍ فَقَالَ لَوْ أَنِّي أَسْقِيكُمْ مِنْ بُضَاعَةَ لَكَرِهْتُمْ ذَلِكَ وَقَدْ وَاللهِ سَقَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بيدي منها.
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Hamza and 'Ali b. Bahr narrated to us (the meaning is one); they both said: Hatim b. Isma'il narrated to us. Muhammad b. Abi Yahya narrated to us, from his mother, who said:
entries.matn_en: We went in to Sahl b. Sa'd al-Sa'idi with some women, and he said: If I were to give you water to drink from Buda'a you would dislike it—yet, by God, I gave the Messenger of God ﷺ to drink from it with my own hand.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا يعقوب بن إسحاق حدثنا يُونس
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ⦗ص: 245⦘ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَقُولُ فِي رُكَى الْمَاءِ إِذَا كَانَ إِلَى جَنْبِهَا رُكَى الْبَوْلِ قَالَ كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ لَوْنُهُ أَوْ رِيحُهُ فَلا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Ya'qub b. Ishaq narrated to us. Yunus narrated to us, who said: [p. 245]
entries.matn_en: al-Hasan used to say, about wells of water beside which are wells of urine: He used to say, so long as its color or smell has not changed, there is no harm in performing ablution from it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا القعنبي حدثنا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْر،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الْمَاءُ الرَّاكِدُ لا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيْءٌ إِذَا كَانَ قَدْرَ ثلاث قلال. قال محمد: القلة مثل الْجَرَّةِ الَّتِي يُسْتَقَى فِيهَا.
entries.isnad_en: al-Qa'nabi narrated to us. Dawud b. Abi al-Furat narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Zayd, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: Still water is not made impure by anything if it is the amount of three qullas. Muhammad said: The qulla is like the jar with which water is drawn.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم حدثنا الربيع بن أبي المينا ثقة
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ الْحَسَنَ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ إنَّا نَكُونُ بِالْهِنْدِ وَهِيَ فَلاةٌ صَحْرَاءُ فِيهِ مَكَانٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ التَّلاجُ وَهُوَ مَجْمَعُ الْمَاءِ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ كَمْ عَرْضُهُ قَالَ وَاسِعٌ يُغْسَلُ فيه الثياب وفي نواحيه الخيف يَغْتَسِلُ فِيهِ الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ قَالَ اغْتَسِلْ مِنْهُ وَاشْرَبْ فَإِنَّ الْمَاءَ لا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيْءٌ.
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Ibrahim narrated to us. al-Rabi' b. Abi al-Mina'—reliable—narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man asked al-Hasan while I was present: We are in India, which is an open desert; in it is a place called al-Tilaj, a gathering-place of water. al-Hasan said: How wide is it? He said: Wide; clothes are washed in it, and along its edges is al-khayf; the person in a state of janaba and the menstruating woman bathe in it. He said: Bathe from it and drink, for water is not made impure by anything.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الطَّيِّبَ بْنَ مَنْصُورٍ الْيَحْمَدِيَّ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ صَحِبْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَمَرَّ بِعَيْنٍ كَثِيرَةِ الْجُعْلانِ وَالْخَنَافِسِ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا، وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى كَأَنَّهُ يُنَحِّي تِلْكَ قَالَ فَتَوَضَّأَ وَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ لَوْلا أَنِّي رَأَيْتُكَ شربت من هذا الماء وتوضأت منه لطابت نَفْسِي أَنْ أَشْرَبَ مِنْهُ وَلا أَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّ الْمَاءَ يُطَهِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ولا ينجسه شيء.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Muhammad b. 'Uthman narrated to us, who said: I heard al-Tayyib b. Mansur al-Yahmadi say:
entries.matn_en: I accompanied Jabir b. Zayd to Mecca. He passed a spring full of dung beetles and scarabs and said, like this—and 'Affan [gestured] with his right hand as though pushing them aside—then he performed ablution and drank from it. I said: O Abu al-Sha'tha', had I not seen you drink from this water and perform ablution from it, I would have been content to drink from it and not perform ablution. He said: My son, water purifies everything and nothing makes it impure.

sections.title_en: Chapter: [On ablution with still water]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: سمعت أبا عبد الله يُسْأَل عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ فَقَالَ يُتَوَضَّأُ منه ولا يتوضأ فيه.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about ablution in still water. He said: One performs ablution from it, but does not perform ablution in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل عَنِ الْبِئْرِ مَاؤُهَا دَائِمٌ فَقَالَ رُبَّمَا كَانَ لَهُ ماؤه، ثم قال: وإن كانت له ماؤه فَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ لا يَجْرِي لَيْسَ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الجاري.
entries.isnad_en: He said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about a well whose water is permanent. He said: Perhaps it has its own water [i.e. a spring feeding it]. Then he said: Even if it has its own water, it is standing and does not flow; it is not in the position of running water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ الْغَدِيرِ يَجْتَمِعُ فِيهَا الْمَاءُ فَيَجِيءُ الرَّجُلُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْهُ فيرى فيه العذرة في نواحيه فجعل يظهر كراهية العذرة.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about a pond in which water collects, and a man comes and performs ablution from it and sees excrement at its edges; he began to show dislike of the excrement.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا سعيد بن عفير حدثني ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ⦗ص: 247⦘ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا سَقَطَ فِي الْبِئْرِ مِمَّا لا يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ إِلا بِذَكَاةٍ فَغَيَّرَ طَعْمَهُ وَرَائِحَتَهُ فَلا يَصْلُحُ الشُّرْبُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يُنْزَفَ] .
entries.isnad_en: Sa'id b. 'Ufayr narrated to us. Ibn Lahi'a narrated to me, from Khalid b. Yazid, [p. 247] from Rabi'a b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman:
entries.matn_en: That he used to say: Whatever falls into a well of those animals whose flesh is not eaten except through ritual slaughter, and changes its taste and smell—it is not fit to drink from it until it is drained.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ الْجُنُبِ يَنْتَهِي إِلَى الْغَدِيرِ قَالَ يَغْتَسِلُ فِي نَاحِيَةٍ مِنْهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Hushaym narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir:
entries.matn_en: That he was asked about a man in a state of janaba who comes to a pond. He said: He bathes at one side of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل عَنِ الْمَصَانِعِ التي بطريق مكة فقال ليس تنجس تِلْكَ عِنْدِي شَيْءٌ قُلْتُ لَهُ وَلا بَوْلٌ وَلا شَيْءٌ قَالَ وَلا بَوْلٌ وَلا شَيْءٌ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْمَاءُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ تِلْكَ المصانع] .
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about the cisterns (masani') on the road to Mecca. He said: Nothing makes those impure, in my view. I said to him: Not even urine, nor anything? He said: Not even urine, nor anything, when the water is plentiful until it is like those cisterns.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The water of the bathhouse

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مَنْصُور قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لإِبْرَاهِيمَ أَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْحَمَّامِ قَالَ: إذا أخذ جحره أجزأك.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Mansur, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Ibrahim: May I bathe with the water of the bathhouse? He said: If he takes its jahr, it suffices you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مُسْلم بن إبراهيم حدثنا محمد يعني ابن دينار قال: حدثنا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ مَاءُ الحمام نجس.
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Ibrahim narrated to us. Muhammad—meaning Ibn Dinar—narrated to us, who said: Abu Raja' narrated to us, who said: I heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: The water of the bathhouse is impure.

sections.title_en: Chapter: On the man and the woman bathing with one water
sections.title_ar: باب [باب في الرجل والمرأة يغتسلان بماء واحد]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا مسدد حدثنا يزيد بن زريع حدثنا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ عَنِ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أَنْ يَتَطَهَّرَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ طَهُورِ الْمَرْأَةِ.
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us. Yazid b. Zuray' narrated to us. Sulayman al-Taymi narrated to us, from Abu Hajib, from a man of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: That the Prophet ﷺ forbade a man to purify himself with the leftover of a woman’s purification water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشْارٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو داود صاحب الطيالسة حدثنا شُعْبة عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِي حَاجِبٍ عَنِ ⦗ص: 249⦘ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْغِفَارِيِّ وَهُوَ الأَقْرَعُ
entries.matn_ar: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الرَّجُلُ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ.
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Bashshar narrated to us, who said: Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi narrated to me. Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Asim al-Ahwal, from Abu Hajib, from [p. 249] al-Hakam b. 'Amr al-Ghifari, who is al-Aqra':
entries.matn_en: That the Prophet ﷺ forbade a man to perform ablution with the leftover of a woman’s ablution water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أيوب بن سليمان الأزدي حدثنا عبد الواحد حدثنا عَاصِمٌ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَرْجِسَ
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ اغْتَسِلا جَمِيعًا هِيَ هَكَذَا، وَأَنْتِ هَكَذَا، قَالَ عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ فِي إِشَارَتِهِ كَانَ الإِنَاءُ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَإِذَا خَلَتْ بِهِ فَلا تَقْرَبَنِّهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Ayyub b. Sulayman al-Azdi narrated to us. 'Abd al-Wahid narrated to us. 'Asim narrated to us, who said: I heard 'Abd Allah b. Sarjis say:
entries.matn_en: Bathe together—she like this and you like this. 'Abd al-Wahid said, in his gesture: the vessel was between them. And when she has been alone with it, do not go near it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أُمِّ سَعْدٍ ابْنَةِ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ امْرَأَةِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَزَيْدٌ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ واحد.
entries.isnad_en: al-Qa'nabi narrated to us. Ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated to us, from his father, from Umm Sa'd daughter of Sa'd b. al-Rabi', wife of Zayd b. Thabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: I used to bathe, I and Zayd, from janaba, from a single vessel.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: سمعت أبا عبد الله يُسْأَل
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ ⦗ص: 250⦘ فَضْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَقَالَ أَمَّا إِذَا خَلَتْ بِهِ فَقَدْ كَرِهَهُ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وأما إذا كانا جميعا فلا بأس به وَاحْتَجَّ بِحَدِيثِ عَائِشَةَ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (Ahmad b. Hanbal) being asked
entries.matn_en: about ablution from [p. 250] a woman’s leftover. He said: As for when she has been alone with it, more than one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ disliked it; and as for when the two [use it] together, there is no harm in it. And he cited the hadith of 'A'isha: “I used to bathe, I and the Prophet ﷺ, from a single vessel.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قِيلَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَالْمَرْأَةُ تَتَوَضَّأُ بِفَضْلِ الرَّجُلِ فَقَالَ أَمَّا الرَّجُلُ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ إِنَّمَا كُرِهَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ.
entries.isnad_en: It was said to Abu 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: What of a woman performing ablution with a man’s leftover? He said: As for the man, there is no harm in it; it is only the woman’s [leftover] that was disliked.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَضْلُ [وضوء] المرأة قال إذا خلت به فلا يتوضأ مِنْهُ إِنَّمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رخص أن يتوضأا معا جَمِيعًا، وَذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَقَالَ هُوَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى أَنَّهُ إِذَا خَلَتْ بِهِ إلى الكراهية.
entries.isnad_en: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah another time:
entries.matn_en: The leftover of a woman’s ablution water? He said: If she has been alone with it, he does not perform ablution from it; the Prophet ﷺ only permitted the two to perform ablution together—and he mentioned the hadith of al-Hakam b. 'Amr and said: It returns to the point that if she has been alone with it, it is disliked.

sections.title_en: Chapter: [On ablution with the leftover of a woman]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا همام حدثنا قَتَادَةُ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ وَسَعِيدٌ يَكْرَهَانِ أَنْ يُتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ فَضْلِ طَهُورِ الْمَرْأَةِ وَلا يَكْرَهَانِ سؤر شرابها.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Hammam narrated to us. Qatada narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Hasan and Sa'id disliked that ablution be performed with the leftover of a woman’s purification water, but they did not dislike the remainder of her drink.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلم بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مَوْلًى لِجُوَيْرِيَةَ عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا رَأَتْهُ يَشْرَبُ فَضْلَ وَضُوئِهَا فَنَهَتْهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Ibrahim narrated to us, from Shu'ba, from al-Muhajir Abu al-Hasan, from a freedman of Juwayriya, from Juwayriya:
entries.matn_en: That she saw him drinking the leftover of her ablution water, and she forbade him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا حفص بن عمر حدثنا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَكَانَتْ هِيَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْتَسِلانِ مِنْ الإِنَاءِ الوَاحِدِ مِنَ الجنابة.
entries.isnad_en: Hafs b. 'Umar narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya, from Abu Salama, from Zaynab bt. Umm Salama, from Umm Salama:
entries.matn_en: That she and the Messenger of God ﷺ used to bathe from janaba from a single vessel.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو حذيفة حدثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ اغْتَسَلَ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَيْمُونَةُ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ فِي جَفْنَةٍ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hudhayfa narrated to us. Ibrahim b. Nafi' narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Umm Hani', who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ and Maymuna bathed from a single vessel, in a large bowl.

sections.title_en: Chapter: [He should not put his hand into the vessel until he has washed it]
sections.title_ar: باب [لا يدخل يده الإناء حتى يغسلها]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ حدثنا أبي حدثنا ⦗ص: 252⦘ الأَشْعَثُ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَقُولُ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَغَمَسَ يَدَهُ فِي إِنَائِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا ثَلاثًا أَهْرَاقَ ذَلِكَ الْمَاءَ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ بِهِ أَوِ اغْتَسَلَ فَهُوَ كَمَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ يُعِيدُ الْوُضُوءَ وَالصَّلاةَ إِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى وإن تناول من الحب فَأَصَابَ طَرَفَ أَصَابِعِهِ الْمَاءُ أَوْ حَمَلَ إِنَاءً فَأَصَابَ الْمَاءُ أَصَابِعَهُ فَلا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ الْمَاءِ أَنْ يُتَوَضَّأَ بِهِ وَيُشْرَبَ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Ubayd Allah b. Mu'adh narrated to us. My father narrated to us. [p. 252] al-Ash'ath narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Hasan used to say: Whoever wakes from his sleep and dips his hand into his vessel before washing it three times, let him pour out that water; and if he performs ablution or bathes with it, he is like one who did not perform ablution—he repeats the ablution and the prayer if he has prayed. But if he reaches into the jar and the water touches the tips of his fingers, or carries a vessel and the water touches his fingers, there is no harm in that water—one may perform ablution with it and drink it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ حدثنا عَائِذٌ عَنْ هِشَامٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ عُرْوَةُ يَنْهَى أَنْ يُدْخِلَ يَدَهُ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ نَوْمِ الليل حتى يغسلها ثلاثا.
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. Numayr narrated to us. 'A'idh narrated to us, from Hisham, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Urwa used to forbid putting one’s hand in [the vessel] when waking from sleep at night until it has been washed three times.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يُسْأَل عَنْ الرَجُلٍ يَسْتَيْقِظُ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَيَغْمِسُ يَدَهُ في الإناء قبل
entries.matn_ar: أن يغسلها فَقَالَ أَمَّا بِالنَّهَارِ فَلَيْسَ بِهِ عِنْدِي بَأْسٌ أَنْ يُدْخِلَ يَدَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغْسِلَهَا وأما إذا قام من النوم بالليل فلا يدخل يده في الإناء قبل أن يغسلها لأَنَّهُ قال لا يدي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ فَالْمَبِيتُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ بِاللَّيْلِ. قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ بِالنَّهَارِ أَيْضًا لا يَدْرِي أَيْنَ كَانَتْ يَدُهُ ⦗ص: 253⦘ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ وَلَكِنِ الْحَدِيثُ فِي الْمَبِيتِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَأَمَّا بِالنَّهَارِ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ. قِيلَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فما يصنع بذلك الْمَاءِ فَقَالَ إِنْ صَبَّ الْمَاءَ أَوْ أَبْدَلَهُ [فهو أسفل. قِيلَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَلَوِ ابْتُلِيتَ أَنْتَ بِهَذَا فَغَمَسْتَ يَدَكَ فِي الإِنَاءِ وَقَدْ قُمْتَ مِنْ نَوْمِ اللَّيْلِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْسِلَهَا كَيْفَ كُنْتَ تَصْنَعُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَصُبُّ ذَلِكَ الْمَاءَ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about a man who wakes from his sleep and dips his hand into the vessel before washing it. He said: As for in the daytime, there is no harm in my view in his putting his hand in before washing it; but if he rises from sleep at night, he does not put his hand into the vessel before washing it, because [the Prophet] said, “he does not know where his hand spent the night”—and spending the night is only at night. I said to Abu 'Abd Allah: But in the daytime too he does not know where his hand has been. [p. 253] He said: Yes, but the hadith concerns spending the night, at night; as for the daytime, there is no harm. It was said to Abu 'Abd Allah: What does he do with that water? He said: If he pours out the water or replaces it, it is safest. It was said to Abu 'Abd Allah: And if you were afflicted with this—you dipped your hand in the vessel after rising from night sleep before washing it—what would you do? He said: I would pour out that water.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا العباس بن عبد العظيم حدثنا روح أخبرنا أَشْعَثُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لا يَرَى فِي نَوْمِ النَّهَارِ غَسْلَ يَدٍ] .
entries.isnad_en: al-'Abbas b. 'Abd al-'Azim narrated to us. Rawh narrated to us. Ash'ath informed us, from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: That he did not consider hand-washing necessary after daytime sleep.

sections.title_en: Chapter: What suffices of water in [ablution and ghusl]
sections.title_ar: باب ما يجزىء من الماء في [الوضوء والغسل]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا مُسْلم بن إبراهيم وعفان قالا حدثنا أبان حدثنا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ⦗ص: 254⦘
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ.
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Ibrahim and 'Affan narrated to us; they both said: Aban narrated to us. Qatada narrated to us, from Safiyya bt. Shayba, from 'A'isha [p. 254]:
entries.matn_en: That the Prophet ﷺ used to perform ablution with a mudd and bathe with a sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مُسْلم بن إبراهيم حدثنا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ أَبِي رَيْحَانَةَ عَنْ سَفِينَةَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ وَيَغْتَسِلُ بِالصَّاعِ] .
entries.isnad_en: Muslim b. Ibrahim narrated to us. Wuhayb narrated to us, from Abu Rayhana, from Safina:
entries.matn_en: That the Prophet ﷺ used to perform ablution with a mudd and bathe with a sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن جعفر حدثنا علي بن عاصم حدثنا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَطَرٍ أَبُو رَيْحَانَةَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَي سَفِينَةُ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يوضيه المد ويغسله الصاع من الجنابة.
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Ja'far narrated to us. 'Ali b. 'Asim narrated to us. 'Abd Allah b. Matar Abu Rayhana narrated to us, who said: Safina, freedman of the Messenger of God, narrated to me:
entries.matn_en: That the Messenger of God ﷺ used a mudd for his ablution and a sa' for his washing from janaba.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مسدد حدثنا [محمد بن فضيل حدثنا حصين عن سالم بن أبي الجَعْد] عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: [يجزىء مِنَ] الْغُسْلِ الصَّاعُ وَمِنَ الْوُضُوءِ الْمُدُّ.
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us. Muhammad b. Fudayl narrated to us. Husayn narrated to us, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A sa' suffices for the ghusl and a mudd for the ablution.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا محمد بن فضيل] حدثنا يزيد بن أبي زياد عن سالم بن أبي الجَعْد عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: [قَالَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم]
entries.matn_ar: يجزىء مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ الْمُدُّ وَمِنَ الْغُسْلِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ الصَّاعُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا يَكْفِينَا الصَّاعُ قال فغضب حتى تربد وجهه، ثم قَالَ: قَدْ كَفَى مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْكَ وأكثر شعرا.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Muhammad b. Fudayl narrated to us. Yazid b. Abi Ziyad narrated to us, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “A mudd suffices for ablution and a sa' for ghusl from janaba.” He said: A man said: A sa' does not suffice us. He said: He became angry until his face darkened, then said: “It sufficed one who is better than you and had more hair.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا القعنبي حدثنا سُلَيْمَانُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَرَجُلا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ يَسْأَلُهُ عَمَّا يَكْفِي الإِنْسَانَ مِنْ غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ فَقَالَ سَعيِدٌ إِنَّ لِي تَوْرًا يَسَعُ مُدَّيْنِ مِنْ مَاءٍ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ فَأَغْتَسِلُ بِهِ فَيَكْفِينِي وَيَفْضُلُ مِنْهُ فضل فقال الرجل فوالله إني لأستنثر وَأَتَمَضْمَضُ بِمُدَّيْنِ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعِيدٌ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي إِنْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَلْعَبُ بِكَ ⦗ص: 256⦘ فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكْفِنِي فَإِنِّي رَجُلٌ كَمَا تَرَى عَظِيمٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعِيدُ ثَلاثَةُ أَمْدَادٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ ثَلاثَةَ أَمْدَادٍ قَلِيلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ سَعِيدٌ فَصَاعٌ. وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: إِنَّ لِي رَكْوَةً أَوْ قَدَحًا مَا يَسَعُ إِلا نِصْفَ الْمُدِّ مَاءً أَوْ نَحْوَهُ ثُمَّ أَبُولُ ثم أتوضأ منه وأفضل من فَضْلا. قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَذَكَرْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ مِنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ لِسُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ فَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ وَأَنَا يَكْفِينِي مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لأَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ فَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ وَهَكَذا، سَمِعْنَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
entries.isnad_en: al-Qa'nabi narrated to us. Sulayman—meaning Ibn Bilal—narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Ata', that he heard Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, with a man of the people of Iraq asking him:
entries.matn_en: …what suffices a person for ghusl from janaba. Sa'id said: I have a tawr (basin) that holds two mudds of water or about that; I bathe with it and it suffices me, with some left over. The man said: By God, I blow my nose and rinse my mouth with two mudds of water! Sa'id said to him: Then what do you ask me to command, if Satan is playing with you? [p. 256] The man said: But if it does not suffice me—I am a man, as you see, of large build. Sa'id said to him: Three mudds. He said: Three mudds is little. Sa'id said to him: Then a sa'. And Sa'id said: I have a small water-pot or cup that holds no more than half a mudd of water or about that; I urinate, then perform ablution from it, and still have some left over. 'Abd al-Rahman said: I mentioned this report which I heard from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab to Sulayman b. Yasar, and Sulayman b. Yasar said: And the like of that suffices me too. 'Abd al-Rahman said: I mentioned it to Abu 'Ubayda b. 'Ammar b. Yasir, and Abu 'Ubayda said: Thus we heard from the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو حذيفة حدثنا عِكْرِمَةُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَمَّارٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ مَرَرْتُ أَنَا وَالْقَاسِمُ بِمِنًى عَلَى قَوْمٍ فَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ اسْقُوا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَسَقَوْهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ فَأُتِيَ بِقَدْرِ نِصْفِ مُدٍّ وَزِيَادَةِ قَلِيلٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hudhayfa narrated to us. 'Ikrima—meaning Ibn 'Ammar—narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: I and al-Qasim passed through Mina by some people, and al-Qasim said: Give Abu 'Abd al-Rahman something to drink. So they gave him to drink; then he called for ablution water, and there was brought about half a mudd and a little more, and he performed ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: قلت لأبي عبد الله يجزىء فِي الْوُضُوءِ مُدٌّ، قَالَ كَذَا جَاءَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِذَا أحسن أن يتوضأ به فهو يجزيه قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ فِي الأَسْفَارِ رُبَّمَا ضَاقَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَاءُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ الرَّجُلُ بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ مد فيجزيه فَقَالَ إِذَا أَحْسَنَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ بِهِ فَهُوَ يجزيه. قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ لا يَمْسَحُ مَسْحًا إِنَّمَا هُوَ [الْغَسْلُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل {فاغسلوا وجوهكم وأيديكم} فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْغَسْلُ لَيْسَ هُوَ الْمَسْحُ، فَإِذَا أَمْكَنَهُ أَنْ يَغْسِلَ بِهِ غَسْلا فَإِنَّ مُدًّا أو أقل أجزأه] .
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Abu 'Abd Allah: Does a mudd suffice for ablution? He said: So it came from the Prophet ﷺ. He said: If he can perform ablution well with it, it suffices him. I said to him: People on journeys sometimes have little water and a man performs ablution with less than a mudd—does it suffice? He said: If he can perform ablution well with it, it suffices him. Abu 'Abd Allah said: He must not merely wipe; it is washing. God Almighty said: “Wash your faces and your hands” [Q. 5:6]. It is washing, not wiping. So if he is able to wash with it properly, then a mudd or less suffices him.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The towel [after ablution and ghusl]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عمر حدثنا علي بن سهل بن المغيرة حدثنا وضاح بن حسان الأنباري حدثنا بَكْرُ بْنُ خُنَيْسٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ⦗ص: 258⦘ سَعِيدٍ بن عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نُسَيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ طَرَفَ رِدَائِهِ فَتَمَسَّحَ بِهِ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Umar narrated to us. 'Ali b. Sahl b. al-Mughira narrated to us. Waddah b. Hassan al-Anbari narrated to us. Bakr b. Khunays narrated to us, from Muhammad b. [p. 258] Sa'id b. 'Ubada b. Nusayy, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ghanm, from Mu'adh b. Jabal, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ perform ablution, then take the edge of his cloak and wipe himself with it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا داود بن شبيب حدثنا حبيب حدثنا عَمْرٌو
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُئِلَ جَابِرٌ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاةِ أَيَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَمْسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ بثوب فقال نعم.
entries.isnad_en: Dawud b. Shabib narrated to us. Habib narrated to us. 'Amr narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: Jabir was asked about a man who performed ablution for prayer: is it permissible for him to wipe his face and hands with a cloth? He said: Yes.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حماد حدثنا عُبَيْدُ اللهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَمْسَحُ وَجْهَهُ بِالمِنْدِيلِ بَعْدَ الوضوء.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Bakr narrated to us, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw Anas b. Malik wipe his face with a handkerchief (mindil) after ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا مُعَاوِيةُ بن عمرو حدثنا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ
entries.matn_ar: قال أرسل أبي مولاة لنا إلى [الحسن] بْنِ عَلِيٍّ فَرَأَتْهُ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiya b. 'Amr narrated to us. Za'ida narrated to us, from Isma'il, from Hakim b. Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: My father sent a freedwoman of ours to al-Hasan b. 'Ali, and she saw him perform ablution and then wipe his face.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دُكَيْن حدثنا مِسْعَرٌ عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَأَيْتُ بَشِيرَ بْنَ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ يَتَمَسَّحُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Mis'ar narrated to us, from Thabit b. 'Ubayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw Bashir b. Abi Mas'ud dry himself with a handkerchief.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حَمَّادٌ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ زَعَمَ حُمَيْدٌ أَنَّ الْحَسَنَ كَانَ يَمْسَحُ وَجْهَهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ وَكَانَ حُمَيْدٌ يفعله.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us, who said: Humayd claimed:
entries.matn_en: That al-Hasan used to wipe his face with a handkerchief after ablution, and Humayd did the same.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة، حدثنا سفيان عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَهُ خرقة يتنشف بِهَا بَعْدَ الْوُضُوءِ.
entries.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. al-Muntashir, from his father, from Masruq:
entries.matn_en: That he had a rag with which he dried himself after ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دُكَيْن حدثنا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سَالِمٍ الأَفْطَسِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْر،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لا يَرَى بِالْمِنْدِيلِ بَأْسًا.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Salim al-Aftas, from Sa'id b. Jubayr:
entries.matn_en: That he saw no harm in the handkerchief.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا قَبِيصَة، حدثنا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لا يَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا يَعْنِي الْمِنْدِيلَ بَعْدَ الوضوء.
entries.isnad_en: Qabisa narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim:
entries.matn_en: That he saw no harm in it—meaning the handkerchief after ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دُكَيْن حدثنا أَبُو إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ سَمِعَهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمِنْدِيلِ فَقَالَ
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَرْضَنَا أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ فَنَحْنُ نتمندل.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Abu Isra'il narrated to us, from al-Hakam, who heard him being asked about the handkerchief:
entries.matn_en: He said: Our land is a cold land, so we use the handkerchief.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دُكَيْن حدثنا مِسْعَرٌ عَنْ سُوَيْدٍ مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَى عَلِيًّا وقد اغتسل فأخذ ثوبا فَلَبِسَهُ أَوْ قَالَ دَخَلَ فِيهِ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Mis'ar narrated to us, from Suwayd, freedman of 'Amr b. Hurayth, from 'Amr b. Hurayth:
entries.matn_en: That he came to 'Ali, who had bathed, and he took a garment and put it on—or he said, entered into it.

sections.title_en: Chapters on what one performs ablution for. Chapter: Ablution from vomiting

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: باب الوضوء من القيء . حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ هِقْلٍ عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاء قَالَ إِنْ قَاءَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Hakam b. Musa narrated to us, from Hiql, from al-Awza'i, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: If he vomits, let him perform ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو حذيفة حدثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ الْقَيْءُ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hudhayfa narrated to us. Ibrahim—meaning Ibn Nafi'—narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Vomiting breaks off the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا الفضل بن دُكَيْن حدثنا سفيان عن مغيرة عن إبراهيم قال:
entries.matn_ar: إذا دسع فليتوضأ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: If he vomits a mouthful (dasa'a), let him perform ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الأَثْرَمُ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ الْقَيْءِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ يَتَوَضَّأُ. قُلْتُ عَلَى إِيجَابِ الْوُضُوءِ قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاحْتَجَّ بِحَدِيثِ ثَوْبَانَ ⦗ص: 262⦘ أَنَا صَبَبْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضُوءَهُ قُلْتُ لَهُ هُوَ يَثْبُتُ عِنْدَكَ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّهُمْ يَضْطَرِبُونَ [في هذا الحديث] فَقَالَ حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ يُجَوِّدُهُ. قُلْتُ لَهُ هُوَ يَقُولُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الأَوْزَاعِيِّ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَاحِدٌ. قُلْتُ لَهُ يَعِيشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ مَعْرُوفٌ قَالَ قَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْهُ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَأَبُوهُ قَالَ أَبُوهُ مَعْرُوفٌ سَمِعَ مِنْهُ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الْمُعَيْطِيُّ وَكَانَ عَامِلَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ. قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فيكون قول ثوبان صدق أَنَا صَبَبْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُضُوءَهُ تَوْكِيدًا لِقَوْلِ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي الْفِطْرِ مِنَ الْقَيْءِ فَذَهَبَ إِلَى أَنَّهُ تَوْكِيدٌ لِلْوُضُوءِ.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I asked Abu 'Abd Allah
entries.matn_en: al-Athram said: I asked Abu 'Abd Allah about ablution from vomiting. He said: Yes, he performs ablution. I said: As an obligation? He said: Yes—and he cited the hadith of Thawban [p. 262]: “I poured out ablution water for the Messenger of God ﷺ.” I said to him: Is it firmly established in your view? He said: Yes. I said to him: They differ [in this hadith]. He said: Husayn al-Mu'allim transmits it well. I said to him: He says ‘from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr’ al-Awza'i. He said: 'Abd Allah and 'Abd al-Rahman are one. I said to him: Ya'ish b. al-Walid is known? He said: [Reports] have been narrated from him. I said to him: And his father? He said: His father is known; Ibn 'Uyayna heard from him; he said: al-Walid b. Hisham al-Mu'ayti narrated to me—he was a governor of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz. I said to Abu 'Abd Allah: So might Thawban’s statement, ‘I poured out the ablution water for the Messenger of God ﷺ’, be a confirmation of Abu al-Darda'’s statement about breaking the fast because of vomiting? He took the view that it is a confirmation of the ablution.

sections.title_en: Chapter: Ablution from cupping

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حدثنا أَبُو قَبِيصَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ يَحْتَجِمُ فَيَغْسِلُ أَثَرَ الْمَحَاجِمِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاةِ فَيُصَلِّي.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr—meaning Ibn Abi Shayba—narrated to us. Abu Qabisa narrated to us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: He used to be cupped, then wash the traces of the cups, then perform his ablution for prayer and pray.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ وَمُحَمَّدٍ أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا يَقُولانِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَحْتَجِمُ يَتَوَضَّأُ وَيَغْسِلُ أَثَرَ الْمَحَاجِمِ.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. 'Abd al-A'la and 'Abd Allah b. Idris narrated to us, from Hisham, from al-Hasan and Muhammad, that both of them used to say:
entries.matn_en: Of a man who is cupped: he performs ablution and washes the traces of the cups.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: قال كان علقمة والأسود لا يغسلان من الحجامة.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Alqama and al-Aswad did not wash after cupping.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يُسْأَل عَنِ الْمُحْتَجِمِ يُصَلِّي وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ أَيُعِيدُ فَقَالَ نعم قِيلَ لَهُ وَيُعِيدُ مَنْ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ ⦗ص: 264⦘ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ مِمَّنْ بِهَذَا أَنَّهُ لا وُضُوءَ فِيهِ فَلا يُعِيدُ وَإِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا لا يَجُوزُ فَتَعْمِدُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يعيدون.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about one who has been cupped and prayed without performing ablution—does he repeat? He said: Yes. It was said to him: And do those who prayed behind him repeat? [p. 264] He said: If he is of those who hold that there is no ablution in this, they do not repeat; but if he knows that this is not permitted and deliberately prays, then they repeat.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل عَنِ الْغُسْلِ من الحجامة فقال لا يغتسل، ثُمَّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ذَاكَ حَدِيثٌ مُنْكَرٌ يَعْنِي حَدِيثَ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَكَأَنَّهُ أُتِيَ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ قَالَ نَعَمْ يروي أحاديث مناكير.
entries.isnad_en: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about washing (ghusl) from cupping. He said: He does not bathe. Then he said: That is a munkar hadith—meaning the hadith of Mus'ab b. Shayba. I said to him: So the fault in it, in your view, comes from Mus'ab b. Shayba? He said: Yes; he transmits munkar hadiths.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَطَاء بْنِ السَّائب
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ رَأَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى يَتَنَخَّمُ دَمًا عبيطا وهو يصلي.
entries.isnad_en: Mu'awiya b. 'Amr narrated to us, from Sufyan b. 'Uyayna, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib:
entries.matn_en: That he saw 'Abd Allah b. Abi Awfa spit out fresh blood while he was praying.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا داود بن شبيب حدثنا حبيب حدثنا عمرو
entries.matn_ar: قال ⦗ص: 265⦘ سئل جابر عن رجل صلى فامتخط في الصلاة فخرج منه شيء يعني مِنْ دَمٍ مَعَ مُخَاطِهِ قَالَ لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاتَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Dawud b. Shabib narrated to us. Habib narrated to us. 'Amr narrated to us, who said: [p. 265]
entries.matn_en: Jabir was asked about a man who prayed and blew his nose during the prayer and something came out—meaning blood together with the mucus. He said: There is no harm in that; let him complete his prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حماد أخبرنا أيوب عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَسْجُدُ فَيُخْرِجُ يَدَيْهِ فَيَضَعُهُمَا عَلَى الأَرْضِ وَهُمَا يَقْطُرَانِ دَمًا مِنْ شِقَاقٍ كَانَ فِي يَدَيْهِ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. Ayyub informed us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar:
entries.matn_en: That he used to prostrate, then bring out his hands and place them on the ground while they were dripping blood from cracks (shiqaq) he had in his hands.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حماد أخبرنا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ
entries.matn_ar: أن ابن عمر عصر بثرة فِي وَجْهِهِ فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ دَمٍ وَقَيحٍ فَمَسَحَهُ بِيَدِهِ وَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ. وَرَأَى رَجُلا قَدِ احْتَجَمَ فَخَرَجَ مِنْ مَحَاجِمِهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ دَمٍ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَأَخَذَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ حصاة فَسَلَتَ الدَّمَ مِنْ قَفَاهُ ثُمَّ دَفَنَهَا.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. Humayd informed us, from Bakr b. 'Abd Allah al-Muzani:
entries.matn_en: That Ibn 'Umar squeezed a pimple on his face and some blood and pus came out; he wiped it away with his hand and prayed, and did not perform ablution. And he saw a man who had been cupped and some blood came out of the cupping marks while he was praying; Ibn 'Umar took a pebble, scraped the blood from his nape, and then buried it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى بِالْقَطْرَةِ وَالْقَطْرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الدَّمِ فِي الصَّلاةِ بَأْسًا.
entries.isnad_en: Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba narrated to us. Sharik narrated to us, from 'Imran b. Muslim, from Mujahid, from Abu Hurayra:
entries.matn_en: That he saw no harm in a drop or two of blood in the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى حدثنا حماد أخبرنا حَجَّاجٌ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَا لَمْ يَغْلِبْكَ الدَّمُ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. Hajjaj informed us, from Maymun b. Mihran, from Abu Hurayra, that he said:
entries.matn_en: “So long as the blood does not overcome you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا حماد أخبرنا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ كُلَّهَا فِي مَنْخَرَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُهَا وَهِيَ مُتَلَطِّخَةٌ بِالدَّمِ فَيَمْسَحُهَا بِشَيْءٍ ثم يصلي ولا يتوضأ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us. Hammad narrated to us. Yahya b. Sa'id informed us, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab:
entries.matn_en: That he used to put all his fingers into his nostrils and bring them out smeared with blood, wipe them on something, then pray and not perform ablution.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا وهيب عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا قِلابَةَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ بِهِ الشِّقَاقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ الدَّمُ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ فِي ذَلِكَ وُضُوءٌ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Affan narrated to us. Wuhayb narrated to us, from Khalid al-Hadhdha', who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Abu Qilaba about a man who has cracks (shiqaq) from which blood comes out. He said: There is no ablution in that.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حدثنا عقبة بن مكرم الضبي حدثنا يونس بن [بكير] حدثنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ أَدْرَكْتُ فُقَهَاءَنَا يَقُولُونَ مَا أَذْهَبَ الْحَكُّ مِنَ الدَّمِ فَلا يَضُرُّ وَمَا أَذْهَبَ الْفَتْلُ مِمَّا يَخْرُجُ من الأنف فلا يضر.
entries.isnad_en: 'Uqba b. Mukram al-Dabbi narrated to us. Yunus b. Bukayr narrated to us. Muhammad b. Ishaq narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ma'mar al-Ansari, who said:
entries.matn_en: I met our jurists saying: Whatever scratching removes of blood does no harm, and whatever twisting [with the finger] removes of what comes out of the nose does no harm.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال الأَثْرَمُ: وسمعت أبا عبد الله يُسْأَل عَنِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ الدَّمِ فَقَالَ إِذَا كَانَ فاحشا. فقيل له ولا توقف فيه
entries.matn_ar: قال لا. قيل له، فإذا قطر أو سال فقال إن كان كثيرا عِنْدَهُ. قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَكَلَّمُوا فِيهِ: أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي أَنْفِهِ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ عَصَرَ بَثْرَةً ⦗ص: 268⦘ وابْنُ أَبِي أوفى تنخم دَمًا وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ إِذَا كَانَ فَاحِشًا وجابر أدخل أصابعه في أنفه. [قيل له يا أبا عبد الله من روى حديث] جابر فقال عبيد الله بن حبيب عن أبي الزبير عن جابر حدثناه وكيع.
entries.isnad_en: al-Athram said: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about ablution from blood. He said: If it is excessive (fahish). It was said to him: And you do not hesitate on it? He said: No. It was said to him: And if it drips or flows? He said: If it is a lot, in his view. Abu 'Abd Allah said: A number of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ spoke on it: Abu Hurayra used to put his fingers in his nose, Ibn 'Umar squeezed a pimple, [p. 268] Ibn Abi Awfa spat out blood, Ibn 'Abbas said, “if it is excessive,” and Jabir put his fingers into his nose. [It was said to him: O Abu 'Abd Allah, who narrated the hadith of] Jabir? He said: 'Ubayd Allah b. Habib, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir; Waki' narrated it to us.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: [حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ حدثنا أبي حدثنا عمران قال: حدثنا لاحِقُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ وهُوَ أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ القيح يكون في
entries.matn_ar: [الثوب] أَوِ الْخِرْقَةِ فَيُعْصَبُ عَلَى الْجُرْحِ فَقَالَ لَمْ أَسْمَعِ اللَّهَ ذَكَرَ الْقَيْحَ وَلَكِنِ الدَّمَ.
entries.isnad_en: 'Ubayd Allah b. Mu'adh narrated to us. My father narrated to us. 'Imran narrated to us, who said: Lahiq b. Humayd—he is Abu Mijlaz—was asked
entries.matn_en: about pus in a garment or a rag bound on a wound. He said: I have not heard God mention pus, but blood.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُسْأَل عَنِ الصَّدِيدِ فقال الصديد كأنه عندي
entries.matn_ar: [إذا لم يكن] فاحشا أن يتوقاه. ⦗ص: 269⦘ قَالَ الأَثْرَمُ: فَفَرَّقَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بَيْنَ الصديد والدم لهذا الاختلاف [في] الدم وأخذ فيه بالاحتياط فقال يعجبني أن يتوقاه.
entries.isnad_en: I heard Abu 'Abd Allah being asked
entries.matn_en: about serous discharge (sadid). He said: The sadid, it seems to me, if it is not excessive, one should avoid it. [p. 269] al-Athram said: So Abu 'Abd Allah distinguished between sadid and blood because of this disagreement over blood, and took precaution in it, saying: I would like him to avoid it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة حدثنا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْجُرْحِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الدَّمِ وَفِيهِ الْوُضُوءُ.
